description: Foundry keystore-based wallet configuration as a free alternative to hardware wallets

deployer.name: deployer
deployer.purpose: Contract deployment, initial ownership, and liquidity funding

backup_recovery.name: backup-recovery
backup_recovery.purpose: Emergency recovery and backup key — used if other keys are lost

multisig_configuration.description: 3-of-5 multisig for contract ownership and emergency actions

security_notes: Keystores are encrypted with AES-128-CTR per Web3 Secret Storage specification
Password is required to decrypt each keystore for signing operations
Private keys NEVER exist in plaintext on disk — only in encrypted keystore JSON
During signing, private key is temporarily exposed in process memory (RAM)
Password files (*.password) are generated for automation — DELETE after deployment
Keystore directory should be backed up to encrypted offline storage
NEVER commit keystores or passwords to version control (git)
Each key should have a UNIQUE strong password in production
For mainnet production deployment, migrate to hardware wallets (Ledger/Trezor)
alternative_note: Foundry encrypted keystore provides password-protected key storage as a free alternative to hardware wallets. Production deployment should use Ledger/Trezor hardware wallets for maximum security.
